Trong bối cảnh toàn cầu hóa, khủng hoảng: Globalization, the climate crisis, and sustainable development pressures make effective, transparent, accountable governance that integrates environmental and social principles increasingly urgent. GISA promotes effective and sustainable governance in both thinking and practice as a strategic pillar.
GISA tiếp cận quản trị từ mô hình hệ thố: GISA approaches governance through a systems model and works toward transformative governance. Organizations must be adaptable, transparent, collaborative, and focused on sustainable value for multiple stakeholders. Green governance addresses environmental impacts while integrating ESG principles into operations, decision-making, and impact assessment.

Các sáng kiến tập trung vào ba lớp năng: These initiatives focus on three layers of capability: governance frameworks, data infrastructure, and leadership for transformation.
Nhóm này tập trung vào đánh giá ESG, quả: This group focuses on ESG assessment, governance for impact, and testing green operating mechanisms.
GISA ESG Navigator — bộ công cụ hỗ trợ d: GISA ESG Navigator — a toolkit that helps businesses, organizations, and localities assess, plan, and improve their performance against ESG criteria, aligning international standards with practical conditions in Vietnam.
Governance for Impact — hỗ trợ tổ chức x: Governance for Impact — helps civil society organizations, businesses, and local authorities build governance systems focused on effectiveness, equity, transparency, and accountability.
GISA Green Governance Lab — không gian t: GISA Green Governance Lab — a testing space for green governance models where local authorities, businesses, and communities co-create sustainable policies and operating mechanisms.
Hai hướng trong nhóm này kết nối quản tr: The two approaches in this group connect urban governance with data for resource and development decisions.
GISA Smart & Green City Governance — hỗ: GISA Smart & Green City Governance — helps cities and industrial parks build digitalized, energy-efficient, and environmentally responsible governance systems.
Data for Sustainability — nền tảng dữ li: Data for Sustainability — an open data platform and analytical tools supporting decisions on resource management, climate change, food security, and spatial planning.
Nhóm này chú trọng năng lực lãnh đạo, th: This group focuses on leadership capabilities, green office practices, and discussions of governance standards.
GISA Future Leadership for Sustainabilit: GISA Future Leadership for Sustainability — develops green and sustainable leadership capabilities among corporate managers, public officials, civil society organizations, and young people.
GISA Green Office Toolkit — hướng dẫn xâ: GISA Green Office Toolkit — guidance for creating green workplaces, covering energy efficiency, waste reduction, digital resource management, and environmentally responsible events.
GISA Ethical Governance Dialogues — chuỗ: GISA Ethical Governance Dialogues — a series of dialogues, research activities, and publications promoting ethical governance in businesses, civil society organizations, and the public sector.
Nhóm cuối tập trung vào củng cố năng lực: The final group focuses on strengthening institutional capabilities and assessing governance systems against sustainability criteria.
GISA Institutional Capacity+ — nâng cao: GISA Institutional Capacity+ — strengthens organizational capabilities in public agencies, nonprofit organizations, and community networks.
GISA Sustainability Audit & Advisory — đ: GISA Sustainability Audit & Advisory — assesses governance systems and advises on improvements against sustainability criteria, including ESG, the Sustainable Development Goals, carbon emissions, and organizational culture.
Trong bối cảnh thế giới đang chuyển mình: As the world rapidly embraces innovation, sustainable development, and global integration, GISA positions collaboration and connection as a strategic driver for a closely integrated ecosystem of knowledge, action, and policy.
GISA chủ động thiết kế các cơ chế hợp tá: GISA actively designs interdisciplinary collaboration mechanisms, organizes programs that connect different fields, and builds platforms for international exchange, connecting researchers, businesses, experts, policymakers, and communities of practice.
Chương trình hợp tác nghiên cứu liên ngà: Interdisciplinary and International Research Collaboration Programs
GISA đóng vai trò xúc tác và điều phối c: GISA catalyzes and coordinates in-depth collaborative research programs among universities, research institutes, science and technology organizations, and experts from different fields in Vietnam and abroad. These programs co-create new knowledge, practical solutions, and adaptable implementation models.
Nền tảng kết nối tri thức – thị trường –: Knowledge, Market, and Policy Connection Platform
GISA phát triển nền tảng dữ liệu động và: GISA develops dynamic data platforms and connection systems linking researchers, businesses, and policymaking bodies. By integrating research information, market initiatives, and priority policy issues, the system narrows the gap between research and implementation.
GISA tổ chức các diễn đàn chiến lược kết: GISA organizes strategic forums connecting three pillars of impact: academia, policy, and markets. These forums provide a space for dialogue, analysis, critical discussion, and co-creation to shape solutions, guide policy, and identify research priorities.
GISA hỗ trợ trực tiếp các nhóm khởi nghi: GISA directly supports startup teams, small enterprises, and community initiatives through expert mentoring, business model coaching, expert connections, and social fundraising, particularly for initiatives focused on sustainable development and social impact.
GISA xây dựng một trung tâm kết nối giữa: GISA builds a hub connecting the public and private sectors, supporting the design and implementation of flexible, transparent, and effective collaboration models, from social infrastructure investment to community innovation initiatives.
GISA Bridge — cầu nối chuyên gia và địa: GISA Bridge — Connecting Experts and Localities
GISA Bridge kết nối các nhà khoa học, ch: GISA Bridge connects scientists, technical experts, designers, and behavioral specialists with localities undergoing socioeconomic transformation, focusing on coaching, co-design, and on-site implementation support.
GISA OpenConnect — nền tảng chia sẻ và h: GISA OpenConnect — Open Sharing and Learning Platform
OpenConnect là hệ sinh thái học tập và c: OpenConnect is an open learning and sharing ecosystem where individuals and organizations can access practical knowledge, application tools, and interdisciplinary courses through digital platforms, tool libraries, learning forums, and communities of practice.
GISA thúc đẩy hình thành và điều phối cá: GISA promotes and coordinates strategic alliances among different regions, sectors, and organizations. These bring together localities with distinctive development potential, priority industries, and key actors such as leading businesses, research institutes, expert networks, and community organizations.
Nhóm hình thức này tạo không gian đối th: These formats provide space for dialogue among multiple stakeholders, connect experts, and expand resources for research and community initiatives.
Đối thoại chính sách và tư vấn đa bên —: Policy Dialogue and Multi-Stakeholder Advisory — forums, workshops, and advisory groups bringing together researchers, businesses, communities, and officials to discuss specific policy issues.
Mạng lưới chuyên gia liên lĩnh vực — tập: Interdisciplinary Expert Network — brings together experts in economics, technology, the environment, education, and mental health. GISA coordinates the network and connects experts with projects, policies, and organizations requiring their expertise.
Bản đồ nghiên cứu và dự án hợp tác mở —: Open Collaborative Research and Project Map — a digital platform that updates, tracks, and publishes ongoing research, innovation, technology transfer projects, and community initiatives.
Chương trình đồng tài trợ sáng kiến cộng: Community Initiative Co-Funding Program — a co-funding mechanism involving businesses, civil society organizations, or local authorities to support local initiatives with potential for wider impact.
Nhóm tiếp theo kết nối hợp tác học thuật: The next group connects academic collaboration with knowledge sharing, mentoring, and local action for sustainable development.
Liên minh học thuật – doanh nghiệp — hợp: Academic–Business Alliance — long-term collaboration among universities, research institutes, and businesses to jointly develop training programs, applied research, and human resources.
Nền tảng học tập mở và chia sẻ tri thức: Open Learning and Knowledge Sharing Platform — a digital ecosystem for sharing toolkits, data, short courses, academic resources, and implementation models.
Mô hình cố vấn và kết nối học tập — kết: Mentoring and Learning Connections — connects experts as mentors with startup teams, local officials, and postgraduate students, alongside peer learning.
Liên kết mạng lưới hành động vì các mục: Action Network Linkages for the Sustainable Development Goals — establishes local action networks to share initiatives, provide technical support, and connect policy, practice, and communities.
